definitions.short: Kadmonite (collectively), the name of a tribe in Palestine
definitions.full: H6935. Qadmoni II. קַדְמֹנִי adjective, of a people with article ׳הַקּ , as proper name collective ( Easterners ); — Gen 15:19 the Kadmonites (in list of peoples); τοὺς Κελμωναίους, ᵐ5 L Κεδμωναίους.
